attr.title: Soma Spirits Rebalance
attr.desc: A choice-driven JRPG about two spirits, Heart and Soul, working to restore balance to the world of Soma. Rebalance is an updated edition of the original 2016 freeware release, with new modes, features, and content.
attr.inst: Download from itch.io Steam version does not work due to DRM, then add the game files (Data, Graphics, Audio, Fonts, Game.rgss3a, Game.ini) to the port folder on your device. It will take a moment to patch on first launch.
